passages.text: Then the Buddha picked up a few rosewood leaves in his hand and addressed the mendicants: “What do you think, mendicants? Which is more: the few leaves in my hand, or those in the grove above?” “Sir, the few leaves in your hand are a tiny amount. There are far more leaves in the grove above.” “In the same way, there is much more that I have directly known but have not explained to you. What I have explained is a tiny amount. And why haven’t I explained it? Because it’s not beneficial or relevant to the fundamentals of the spiritual life.
passages.note: Focusing on what truly helps rather than knowing everything
